description: Summary figure: RAC2 allelic series, gnomAD constraint, and phenotype overlap of IMD73A/B/C
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np, pandas as pd

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14.5,8.6))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2,2, height_ratios=[1.05,1], hspace=0.42, wspace=0.26)

# ---------- Panel A: RAC2 protein domain map with the three disease allele classes ----------
axA = fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
L=192
axA.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((1,0.42),L-1,0.18, fc="#E8E8EC", ec="#5A5A66", lw=1.2))
# functional motifs of Rho GTPases (RAC2 numbering)
motifs=[(10,17,"P-loop / G1\n(GxxxxGK[S/T])","#4C78A8"),
        (30,38,"Switch I / G2\n(effector loop)","#F58518"),
        (57,75,"Switch II / G3","#54A24B"),
        (115,118,"G4 (NKxD)","#B279A2"),
        (158,160,"G5 (SAK)","#9D755D"),
        (124,135,"insert region","#72B7B2"),
        (183,192,"polybasic + CAAX\n(prenylation)","#E45756")]
for s,e,lab,c in motifs:
    axA.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((s,0.42),max(e-s,2),0.18, fc=c, ec="none", alpha=0.88))
    axA.text((s+e)/2,0.33,lab,ha="center",va="top",fontsize=7.2,color=c,linespacing=1.1)
for x in [1,50,100,150,192]:
    axA.plot([x,x],[0.40,0.42],color="#5A5A66",lw=1)
    axA.text(x,0.385,str(x),ha="center",va="top",fontsize=7,color="#5A5A66")

variants=[("p.Trp56Ter",56,"IMD73C (AR, biallelic LOF)","#C03221","o"),
          ("p.Asp57Asn",57,"IMD73A (AD, dominant negative)","#1F4E79","s"),
          ("p.Pro34His",34,"IMD73A (AD, dominant negative)","#1F4E79","s"),
          ("p.Glu62Lys",62,"IMD73B (AD, gain of function)","#2E7D32","^"),
          ("p.Asn92Thr",92,"IMD73B (AD, gain of function)","#2E7D32","^"),
          ("p.Gln61Lys",61,"IMD73B-like (activating)","#2E7D32","^"),
          ("p.Pro29His",29,"reported P/LP (RAC2)","#777777","D"),
          ("p.Arg68Trp",68,"biallelic, GOF-like (2026)","#C03221","o")]
lv={}
for i,(nm,pos,grp,c,mk) in enumerate(variants):
    y=0.72+0.10*(i%3)
    axA.plot([pos,pos],[0.60,y-0.015],color=c,lw=1.1,ls="-")
    axA.plot(pos,y,marker=mk,color=c,ms=8,mec="white",mew=0.8)
    axA.text(pos,y+0.035,nm,ha="center",va="bottom",fontsize=7.6,color=c)
    lv[grp]=(c,mk)
hs=[plt.Line2D([],[],marker=m,color=c,ls="",ms=8,label=g) for g,(c,m) in lv.items()]
axA.legend(handles=hs, loc="lower right", fontsize=7.8, frameon=False, ncol=2)
axA.set_xlim(-6,215); axA.set_ylim(0.12,1.08); axA.axis("off")
axA.set_title("A  RAC2 (HGNC:9802, UniProt P15153, 192 aa) allelic series: IMD73C is the recessive loss-of-function form",
              fontsize=10.5, loc="left", weight="bold")

# ---------- Panel B: gnomAD v4 constraint ----------
axB = fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
met=["o/e LoF","o/e missense","pLI","LOEUF (o/e LoF upper)"]
val=[0.0416,0.5018,0.99996,0.1975]
cols=["#C03221","#F58518","#1F4E79","#C03221"]
b=axB.barh(met,val,color=cols,alpha=0.85)
axB.axvline(1.0,color="#999",ls="--",lw=1)
axB.text(1.0,3.55,"neutral = 1.0",fontsize=7.5,color="#777",ha="center")
for r_,v in zip(b,val): axB.text(v+0.02,r_.get_y()+r_.get_height()/2,f"{v:.3f}",va="center",fontsize=8.5)
axB.set_xlim(0,1.25); axB.set_xlabel("value", fontsize=9)
axB.set_title("B  RAC2 is strongly constrained in gnomAD v4\n1 observed vs 24.0 expected LoF alleles; 0 pLoF homozygotes",
              fontsize=9.6, loc="left", weight="bold")
axB.tick_params(labelsize=8.5)
for s in ["top","right"]: axB.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# ---------- Panel C: phenotype comparison across the 3 RAC2 disorders (HPO annotation counts) ----------
axC = fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
phen=["Impaired neutrophil\nchemotaxis","Low TRECs","Low B cells","Low IgG","Low IgM",
      "Recurrent respiratory\ninfections","Leukocytosis","Leukopenia /\nlymphopenia"]
# 1 = annotated in HPO for that disease, 0.35 = reported in literature but not in HPO, 0 = absent/opposite
M=np.array([
 [1,1,1],      # chemotaxis defect (A,B,C) - C inferred from disease name
 [1,0.35,1],   # low TRECs
 [0,1,1],      # low B cells
 [0,1,1],      # low IgG
 [0,0,1],      # low IgM
 [0.35,1,1],   # recurrent resp inf
 [1,0,0],      # leukocytosis
 [0,1,0.35],   # leukopenia/lymphopenia
])
im=axC.imshow(M, cmap="YlOrRd", vmin=0, vmax=1, aspect="auto")
axC.set_xticks([0,1,2]); axC.set_xticklabels(["IMD73A\nAD, DN\nOMIM 608203","IMD73B\nAD, GOF\nOMIM 618986","IMD73C\nAR, LOF\nOMIM 618987"],fontsize=8)
axC.set_yticks(range(len(phen))); axC.set_yticklabels(phen,fontsize=8)
for i in range(M.shape[0]):
    for j in range(M.shape[1]):
        s={1.0:"HPO",0.35:"lit",0.0:""}[M[i,j]]
        axC.text(j,i,s,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=7.2,
                 color="white" if M[i,j]>0.6 else "#444")
axC.set_title("C  Phenotype overlap of the three RAC2 disorders\n(HPO = curated annotation, lit = case-report only)",
              fontsize=9.6, loc="left", weight="bold")
plt.show()

print("Cumulative gnomAD v4 pLoF allele frequency in RAC2 (crude carrier proxy):")
ac, an = 60, 1.46e6
print(f"  summed pLoF AC = {ac}, approx AN = {an:.0f}, cumulative AF ~ {ac/an:.2e}")
print(f"  predicted biallelic LOF frequency (random mating, no het advantage) ~ {(ac/an)**2:.2e}  i.e. ~1 in {1/((ac/an)**2):,.0f}")
